top_level.config: Human-confirmed identity, profile, strategy, and policy inputs.
top_level.data: Observed or normalized business facts grouped by domain.
top_level.work: Mutable decisions and production artifacts derived from data.
top_level.presentation: Rendered read models for human review; never a source.
top_level.archive: Legacy, migration, and temporary artifacts excluded from automation.

state_rules.raw: Source-faithful captures. Append or supersede; do not silently reinterpret.
state_rules.current: Canonical normalized snapshot used by workflows. One explicit manifest pointer per entity.
state_rules.work: Rebuildable decisions or plans. May be ready, degraded, blocked, or invalidated.
state_rules.presentation: Rebuildable from current data and ready work only.
state_rules.runs: Write-once audit trail. Later corrections append invalidation metadata.

source_precedence: first-party platform metrics and user interactions
current strategy-health assessment derived from first-party evidence

domains.function: Define account, audience, offer, value promise, and durable boundaries.
Constrain topic search and ranking with confirmed direction and exclusions.
domains.boundary: A topic, tool, experiment, account symptom, or workflow stage is not strategy.

domains.function: Configure how stable workflow nodes search, rank, and research references without changing account direction.
domains.boundary: Policies may change workflow behavior but may not redefine the account audience, positioning, or confirmed direction.

domains.function: Diagnose current performance and produce execution constraints.
forbidden_effects: turn a metric into account direction
create a topic without a traceable opportunity signal

domains.function: Assess content-strategy health from first-party performance without overwriting confirmed strategy, then build a strategy-bounded topic search space and record attributable topic opportunities.
domains.boundary: Assessment may continue, optimize execution, run an experiment, or propose a content-strategy adjustment; it may never overwrite positioning or confirmed strategy.

domains.function: After candidate topics exist, supply hook, proof, structure, pacing, and CTA patterns.
domains.boundary: Supply-side popularity may validate attention or packaging, but cannot change account strategy by itself.

domains.function: Build physically isolated conservative and experimental topic lanes, rank inside each lane, then mix them at a separate 60/40 selection gate.
domains.required_lineage: topic_id -> lane -> strategy_id -> strategy_assessment_id -> account_fit -> search_scope_ids -> signal_ids; pain_id is optional
domains.boundary: Each lane and the mixed selection have one writer. Experimental topics cannot overwrite or auto-promote into the conservative lane.

domains.function: Apply operations constraints and benchmark patterns to validated topics.
domains.boundary: A blocked plan contains no executable topics and cannot render or publish.

domains.function: Record real publishing and performance outcomes for the next operations cycle.
domains.boundary: Feedback may propose strategy changes but cannot overwrite confirmed strategy.

domains.function: Render upstream facts without inventing conclusions, scores, or freshness.
domains.boundary: Presentation is never read as business evidence.
